title: 学習・言語心理学
subtitle: Psychology of Learning and Language
educationalGoal: In this course, we will study high-level cognitive processes such as language and learning that support human intellectual activities. Beginning with behavioral learning theory, we will explain the model of knowledge acquisition in cognitive psychology. In addition, we will explain the characteristics and acquisition process of language as a tool for communication and thinking. Based on this knowledge, the goal is for students to be able to improve their own daily activities and apply them to the real world.
advice: We use language, learn various things from past experiences, and change our behavior to live a smooth life. Language also distinguishes humans from other animals and plays a vital role in various cognitive activities. In this course, we aim to teach specialized knowledge on learning and language that supports our higher level cognitive activities, based on what was learned in previous courses. Language and learning are associated with various interesting phenomena in our daily lives. I hope the lessons learned in this course will be used to understand the various phenomena experienced in daily life. Classes will be centered on lectures, but exercises will be introduced as needed to aid understanding.
books: Reference books are indicated in each topic.
requiredKnowledge: Fully understand basic information on learning, cognition and language learned from previous courses. Be sure to fully understand the basic operations of a PC, as it may be necessary to perform exercises using a PC.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand various types of learning.
Ability to understand the theories of respondent conditioning and operant conditioning.
Ability to understand the role of social context in learning and language acquisition.
Ability to understand the characteristics of language acquisition different from learning in general.
Ability to understand the role of language in learning, thinking, and cognition.

achievementLevels.ideal: Ability to understand the types of learning and apply the knowledge to explain various phenomena in daily life. Ability to understand and explain the difference between respondent conditioning and operant conditioning. Ability to understand the role of social situations in learning. Ability to understand and explain the characteristics of human language. Ability to understand and explain the language acquisition process. Ability to understand these findings and apply them to explainf various phenomena experienced in daily life.
achievementLevels.standard: Ability to understand the different types of human learning. Ability to understand the differences between respondent and operant conditioning in behavioral learning theory. Ability to understand the role of social situations in learning. Ability to understand the characteristics of human language. Ability to understand the language acquisition process. Based on these findings, explain various phenomena experienced in daily life.

lessons.content: Course introduction Review basic knowledge on learning and language
lessons.assignments: Review related topics learned in previous classes

lessons.content: Learning Theory and concepts in classical conditioning
lessons.assignments: Review: List and analyze phenomena in everyday life that are thought to involve respondent conditioning.

lessons.content: Learning Operant conditioning (1) Basic theory and concepts
lessons.assignments: Review: Understand the basic concept of operant conditioning and try to explain the phenomena in everyday life.
Review: Think about the application of operant conditioning to various areas.

lessons.content: Learning Learning theory beyond behaviorism social learning, observational learning
lessons.assignments: Review: List and analyze phenomena in everyday life that are thought to involve social learning and observational learning.

lessons.content: Learning Learning in social context Situated cognition, expertise
lessons.assignments: Review: Find exmaples of learning in social context, and analyze them based on the concept of situated cognition. Prepare for the midterm test.

lessons.content: Midterm test on Learning Language Four research areas of language (phonetics, vocabulary, syntactics, pragmatics)
lessons.assignments: Review: Find and analyze examples of everyday language problems applying each of the four areas

lessons.content: Language Phonetics: characteristics of speech sound, utterance, speech perception
lessons.assignments: Review: Analyze the characteristics of the sounds of speech
Review: Find cases of the vocabulary acquisition process in your own experiences or in familiar children, and analyze them

lessons.content: Language Syntactics and development of grammatical skill
lessons.assignments: Review: Find cases of the grammatical skill acquisition process in your own experiences or in children you know, and analyze them
Review: Examine pragmatic issues in the experience of using language in everyday life.
Review: Looking back on your learning experience, examine the role of language in thinking and learning.

lessons.content: Language Biological base of language and disorder
lessons.assignments: Review: Understand the biological basis and disabilities of language while correlating them with the knowledge of brain function learned so far. Prepare for the final exam.

lessons.content: Review of the entire classes Final exam
Review of important concepts in the course Self-reflection class
